name: Lagos Comic Con
blurb: West Africa's longest-running comic con, held at Landmark Event Centre in Lagos with comics, animation, gaming and film programming.
notes: Homepage only promotes the 15th edition ('RETURNS 12TH SEPTEMBER 2026... BUY TICKET'), which already ended before today (2026-10-05); no 2027 edition is announced anywhere on the site. A web search corroborates Sept 12-13, 2026 at Landmark Event Centre, Oniru, Victoria Island (matching the seed note and the site's own '7,000+ Attendees' stat), so that is recorded as the last edition. No organizer company name found on-site (footer only credits the web designer).
